candidates: When inserting new entries into a CLI flags array that will be passed to `executeCommand` (or a similar subprocess helper), check whether the array includes a `--` argument-separator and insert the new flags in the correct position relative to it. Flags pushed before `--` are consumed by the invoking command; flags pushed after `--` are forwarded to the subprocess. Misplacing a flag on the wrong side of the separator silently changes which process receives it.
